title: Family Matters
intro: [excited] Welcome to the family reunion episode! Tonight it's moms, dads, big sisters, little brothers, and at least one wicked stepmother. Grab a seat at the kids' table, because some of you are going to need it.

art.prompt: A giant cozy family dinner table in a warm cottage dining room set for a reunion, mismatched chairs from tiny to huge, a roast and a towering cake, framed silhouette portraits on the walls, a crackling fireplace Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

categories.title: Supers at the Dinner Table
categories.intro: Our film category stars the most super family in animation. [chuckles] Please, no capes.

art.prompt: A sleek mid-century modern suburban dining room mid-chaos, a dinner table with a stretched-out spilled pitcher, a scorched high chair, plates flying, red and orange retro supersuit fabrics draped over chairs Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Mr. Incredible's super-stretchy wife goes by this hero name.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Elastigirl! Also known as Helen Parr, super mom. [sarcastic] She can stretch across a room, which is exactly how far my mom could reach in the car.

clues.clue: The Parr family's super-speedy son.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Dash! He's so fast he can run on water. [laughs] Also very fast at escaping homework.

clues.clue: The Parrs' baby turns out to have a whole bunch of powers, including turning into a fiery little monster.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Jack-Jack! He even fought a raccoon. Every parent knows the feeling of a baby with too many powers.

clues.clue: This tiny fashion designer to the supers insists: No capes!
clues.reveal: [dramatic pause] The correct answer is Edna Mode! Darling, she does not do capes. [whispers] But she did babysit Jack-Jack in Incredibles 2, and loved every minute of it.

clues.clue: The Incredibles' writer and director also provides the voice of Edna Mode himself.
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is Brad Bird! His scratch voice was so good that Lily Tomlin reportedly told him to just do it himself. [laughs] True Pixar nerds, take a bow.

categories.title: Sibling Rivalry
categories.intro: [excited] Brothers, sisters, and the occasional jealous uncle. If you have a sibling, they are probably going to beat you in this category.

art.prompt: Two matching bedroom doors side by side in a castle hallway, one frosted with ice crystals and one decorated with sunny paint and flowers, a single snowflake and a single paintbrush on the floor between them Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Elsa's fearless little sister, who just wants to build a snowman.
clues.reveal: [cheerful] The correct answer is Anna! Do you want to build a snowman? Okay, bye. Classic little sister move, knocking on the door forty times.

clues.clue: Mufasa's jealous little brother, who has a scar over his eye and a pack of hyenas.
clues.reveal: [chuckles] The correct answer is Scar! Life's not fair, is it? Proof that some sibling rivalries really get out of hand.

clues.clue: In Brother Bear, the youngest of three brothers is magically turned into a bear.
clues.reveal: [playfully] The correct answer is Kenai! Big brothers Sitka and Denahi round out the trio, and Koda is the chatty cub who tags along. Plus the moose. [mischievously] Eh, the moose.

clues.clue: Cinderella's red-haired stepsister, the one who plays the flute.
clues.reveal: [impressed] The correct answer is Anastasia! Drizella sings while Anastasia plays the flute, and nobody's ears survive. Those dark curls belong to Drizella.

clues.clue: In Onward, brothers Ian and Barley share this family last name.
clues.reveal: [whispers] The correct answer is Lightfoot! Tom Holland and Chris Pratt voiced the elf brothers, and their dad was a pair of walking pants. [sarcastic] Family is complicated.

categories.title: Because I Said So
categories.intro: You'll hear a famous line from a Disney parent or grandparent. Tell me who said it. [mischievously] And sit up straight while you do it.

art.prompt: A grand throne room drawing room with a long dramatic shadow of a pointing finger across a marble floor, an hourglass, a stack of rule scrolls and a stern golden armchair Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Which Disney parent figure said this?
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Mother Gothel! Rapunzel's not-actually-mom from Tangled. [laughs] Spoiler alert: mother did not, in fact, know best.

clues.clue: Which Disney dad said this?
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Mufasa! He said it from the stars. Remember who you are. Also remember to wear sunscreen, that's from my dad.

clues.clue: Which Disney grandma said this, over and over?
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Abuelita from Coco! Her name is Elena, and her chancla is legendary. [whispers] Mama Imelda banned music first, but Abuelita enforces it.

clues.clue: Which Disney dad said this?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is King Triton! Right before he trashed Ariel's grotto. Reasonable merman? [laughs] Ask the statue of Prince Eric.
clues.quote: I consider myself a reasonable merman.

clues.clue: Which Disney mom said this at the dinner table?
clues.reveal: [impressed] The correct answer is Queen Elinor! Merida's mum in Brave, right before Merida plops her bow down anyway. Moms, keep fighting the good fight.
clues.quote: Merida, a princess does not place her weapons on the table.

categories.title: Family Vacation
categories.intro: Load the minivan, kids, we're going to the parks. [laughs] These clues are all about family time at Disney.

art.prompt: A sunny theme park entrance plaza with a flower bed shaped like a round face, a stroller parked with balloons tied to it, a red steam train station, a fairy-tale castle in the distance Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Cinderella Castle is the centerpiece of this Walt Disney World theme park.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Magic Kingdom! Disneyland has Sleeping Beauty Castle. [chuckles] Get the castles mixed up at a family dinner and see what happens.

clues.clue: This Disney service lets one grown-up ride while the other waits with a little one, then swap without waiting in line again.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Rider Switch! Parents everywhere, rejoice. [mischievously] You can both ride Space Mountain and still have someone holding the stroller.

clues.clue: The Swiss Family Treehouse is in this land at Magic Kingdom.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Adventureland! The tree is not real, but the climb up those stairs absolutely is. Your legs will remember this family vacation.

clues.clue: In Walt Disney's Carousel of Progress, the cheerful father who guides you through each era is named this.
clues.reveal: [dramatic pause] The correct answer is John! He's joined by his wife Sarah and the family dog Rover. [sarcastic] There's a great big beautiful tomorrow, and John is always excited about it.

clues.clue: Walt said the idea for Disneyland came to him while watching his daughters ride the merry-go-round at this Los Angeles park.
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is Griffith Park! Walt sat on a bench watching Diane and Sharon ride the carousel. That bench is now at Disneyland. [laughs] Dads really do dream big.

categories.title: Who's Your Daddy?
categories.intro: [dramatic pause] The Club DJ members wanted to celebrate Disney dads. I name the kid, you name the father. Dad jokes come free.

art.prompt: A dad's workshop and den filled with treasures: a clownfish anemone fish tank, a quirky wood-chopping invention with gears, a ceremonial carved oar, a chef's toque, and a lacquered paper lantern Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: This clownfish swims across the ocean to find his son, Nemo.
clues.reveal: [cheerful] The correct answer is Marlin! An overprotective dad who crossed the entire ocean. I can't even get my dad to cross the parking lot.

clues.clue: Belle's eccentric inventor father.
clues.reveal: [chuckles] The correct answer is Maurice! Philippe is the horse. [whispers] Gaston is not anyone's dad, but he does use antlers in all of his decorating.

clues.clue: Moana's father, the chief of Motunui, who warns her not to go past the reef.
clues.reveal: [playfully] The correct answer is Chief Tui! He sings Where You Are. Spoiler, Moana goes beyond the reef anyway. [laughs] Kids never listen.

clues.clue: Tiana's dad, who dreamed of opening a restaurant with her.
clues.reveal: [impressed] The correct answer is James! Voiced by Terrence Howard. His gumbo inspired Tiana's Palace. Eli is Charlotte's dad, Big Daddy La Bouff.

clues.clue: Mulan's father, whose place she takes in the army.
clues.reveal: [whispers] The correct answer is Fa Zhou! Fa Li is her mom. Mulan took his armor and his sword, and he was proud of her anyway. [chuckles] Best dad ever.
